problem:
What are the pivot columns of the matrix $P,$ given by

$$
P=[\begin{aligned}0 & 1 & 0 & 2 & 0 & 3 \\ 0 & 0 & 3 & 0 & 6 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & -6 & 0 & -4 & -1 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0 & -8 & 0\end{aligned}]?
$$

examples.knowledge_point: Finding the Pivot Columns of a Matrix
examples.problem:
What are the pivot columns of the matrix $B,$ given by

$$
[\begin{aligned}1 & -5 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 2 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & -4 & 7 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 2\end{aligned}]
$$
examples.worked_solution:
First, we need to convert $B$ to row echelon form:

$$
\begin{aligned}B & =[\begin{aligned}1 & -5 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 2 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & -4 & 7 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 2\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+2{R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -5 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 2 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 7 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 2\end{aligned}] & {R}_{4} & :={R}_{4}+(-\frac{2}{7}){R}_{3} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -5 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 2 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 7 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}] & \end{aligned}
$$

Looking at the row echelon form, we see that $B$ has $3$ pivots. In particular, the pivot columns are the $1$st, $3$rd, and $4$th columns.

feedback.problem:
Determine the number of pivot columns of the matrix $D,$ given by

$$
D=[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 0 & 4 & -7 & 5 \\ 0 & 0 & 2 & 3 & 1 & 0 \\ 5 & 0 & 0 & 20 & -35 & 24\end{aligned}].
$$
feedback.worked_solution:
First, we need to convert $D$ to row echelon form:

$$
\begin{aligned}D & =[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 0 & 4 & -7 & 5 \\ 0 & 0 & 2 & 3 & 1 & 0 \\ 5 & 0 & 0 & 20 & -35 & 24\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+(-5){R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 0 & 4 & -7 & 5 \\ 0 & 0 & 2 & 3 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0 & 0 & -1\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

Looking at the row echelon form, we see that $D$ has $3$ pivots, and therefore the number of pivot columns is $3.$
